title: A Prostitute Serving the Public and in Compliance with the Laws of the State
writer: Barbara Alberti, Amedeo Pagani, Italo Zingarelli
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Giancarlo Giannini, Denise Bataille
plot: A prostitute and mother of two leaves her abusive husband for a young boxer; on the streets she gets assaulted and beaten by pimps.
